capabilities: Filter publishable notes by tag, frontmatter key, title, path, or content regex, combined with AND, OR, and NOT
Copy matching notes and their attachments to a configured publishing folder
Preview matching files with new, modified, deleted, or unmodified status and file diffs before publishing
Commit and push changes to the target Git repository, or commit locally only
extras: README discloses network use, access outside the vault, running external git commands, and AI agents used during development, per Obsidian developer policies; the plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Publishes via the GitHub API rather than a local Git repository.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push only selected notes and attachments to a Git-hosted site while reviewing the exact changes before they are committed.

relations.evidence: Publishes via the GitHub API rather than a local Git repository.
Publishes through authentication to different Git providers.
the repository should typically contain a static site generator which is able to process Obsidian Markdown files, such as Quartz

summary: Publishes selected notes and attachments to a Git repository, filtering by tag, frontmatter, path, title, or content with a diff preview before publishing.
